paragraphs.chinese:
这一集都是从家里一些看起来不大的问题开始，最后却越吵越大，因为谁都不愿意直接承认自己到底做了什么，或者自己真正介意的是什么。

在 Dunphy 家，Claire 在家庭电脑上发现了一张色情图片，立刻认定是 Luke 看过的。Phil 一眼就知道真相：那张图其实是公司里的同事发给他的。可他没有马上承认，反而让 Claire 继续以为是 Luke，然后说这场父子之间的谈话交给自己处理。

可 Phil 和 Luke 的谈话完全鸡同鸭讲。Luke 前不久偷偷看了 Haley 的日记，所以 Phil 一开口问“看完以后怎么彻底删掉东西”，Luke 就以为自己偷看日记的事被发现了。Phil 离开时以为 Luke 已经听懂自己的性教育，Luke 离开时却以为爸爸居然知道了日记那件事。

后来 Luke 主动告诉 Claire，自己看了不该看的东西。Claire 很认真地开始跟他聊性，结果才发现 Luke 说的是 Haley 的日记，不是那张图片。这一下三个孩子又吵成一团。等所有人都否认那张图片是自己的，Phil 终于再也躲不下去了。Claire 真正介意的其实不是图片本身，而是一想到 Luke 正在长大，她就很难受。而 Phil 还让 Luke 白白背了锅，只把事情搞得更糟。

与此同时，Jay 买回家一个非常夸张的摆件：一只穿成管家的大狗。他叫它 Barkley，而且是真的喜欢得不得了。Gloria 却非常讨厌，因为她每次一转弯都以为屋里站着个陌生男人。她先偷偷把 Barkley 搬到客房，后来搬动时又不小心把它的一只手扯了下来。

Jay 火了，很快两个人吵的就不只是 Barkley。Gloria 说自己平时也忍了很多 Jay 喜欢的东西，Jay 则开始抱怨她在床上堆了一大堆装饰抱枕，每晚睡觉跟搬货一样。谁都不想先退一步。

Mitchell 和 Cameron 本来约好带 Lily 去看 Mitchell 小时候很喜欢的木偶戏。刚准备出门，Cameron 看见园丁情绪很低落，就把人请了进来。Cameron 的西班牙语其实很差，但这丝毫不影响他自信满满地想帮忙。Mitchell 越来越烦，因为 Cameron 几乎只要看到别人有点困难，就能立刻放下他们原来的计划。

Mitchell 最后自己走了。后来他又意识到，Cameron 这种见谁都想帮一把的性格，本来也是自己喜欢他的原因之一。他回家准备道歉，结果发现 Cameron 已经把客厅变成了园丁的婚礼现场。原来园丁根本不是失恋，他只是因为当天要结婚而紧张。

这几场争执最后都没人真正“赢”。他们只是再次发现，那些让你抓狂的习惯，本来就是你选择一起生活的这个人的一部分。
paragraphs.english:
This episode starts with a few small problems around the house, but every one of them turns into a much bigger argument because nobody wants to admit what they really did or what’s really bothering them.

At the Dunphy house, Claire finds a dirty picture on the family computer and assumes Luke was looking at it. Phil knows the truth immediately: the picture was sent to him by a guy from work. Instead of admitting that, he lets Claire believe it was Luke and says he’ll handle the father-son talk himself.

The conversation goes nowhere because Luke thinks Phil is talking about something completely different. Luke secretly read Haley’s journal, so when Phil starts asking about deleting things after you look at them, Luke assumes he’s been caught. Phil walks away thinking Luke has understood his lecture, while Luke walks away thinking his dad somehow knows about the journal.

Later, Luke tells Claire he looked at something he shouldn’t have. Claire starts giving him a careful talk about sex, then realizes he means Haley’s journal. That sets off another fight between the kids, and once everyone says the dirty picture wasn’t theirs, Phil finally has nowhere left to hide. Claire isn’t really shocked by the picture itself. What bothers her is the idea that Luke is growing up, and Phil made it worse by letting him take the blame.

Meanwhile, Jay has bought a ridiculous statue of a dog dressed as a butler. He calls him Barkley and genuinely loves him. Gloria hates Barkley because every time she turns a corner, she thinks there’s a strange man standing in the house. She tries moving him into the guest room, then accidentally tears off his hand.

Jay gets angry, and pretty soon the fight isn’t really about Barkley anymore. Gloria says she puts up with plenty of things Jay likes, while Jay starts complaining about the mountain of decorative pillows she puts on their bed. Neither of them wants to be the one who gives in.

Mitchell and Cameron are supposed to take Lily to a puppet show Mitchell loved as a kid. Just before they leave, Cameron sees their gardener looking upset and invites him inside. Cameron barely speaks Spanish, but that doesn’t stop him from trying to help. Mitchell gets more and more annoyed because Cameron will drop almost any plan the second a stranger needs something.

Mitchell leaves without him, then later realizes that Cameron’s need to help people is also one of the things he loves about him. He comes home ready to apologize and discovers that Cameron has turned their living room into the gardener’s wedding venue. The gardener wasn’t heartbroken at all—he was nervous because he was getting married that day.

Nobody really wins any of the arguments. They just end up remembering that the annoying habits come with the people they chose to live with.
